svg.title: DS41RT v6 parallelism experiments and RAM-backed KV
svg.desc: Two independent serving lanes use two RTX GPUs and four Spark expert workers. Independent experimental switches split attention with replicated KV, query and output projections, and dSpark routed experts. They remain disabled unless performance wins. A configurable bottom-up routed-expert boundary divides RTX tensor-parallel layers from Spark layers. Automatic RAM paging increases logical token capacity beyond twenty leading-edge slots times the configured context limit. Replicated GPU copies count once.
svg.text: V6 • useful parallelism, bounded cache pressure
Experimental GPU splits stay off by default until serving measurements establish a win.

Replicated KV counts once. Snapshot overhead and restore staging are reserved separately; RAM paging is not active GPU capacity.
